changeSet.author: waste-submit-reg
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE reg_registration_submission ( id uuid NOT NULL CONSTRAINT pk_reg_registration_submission PRIMARY KEY, organisation_id uuid NOT NULL, compliance_scheme_id uuid, registration_year integer NOT NULL, journey varchar(40) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT ck_reg_registration_submission_journey CHECK (journey IN ('DirectLargeProducer', 'DirectSmallProducer', 'CsoLargeProducer', 'CsoSmallProducer', 'CsoLegacy')), -- The Nations id used everywhere in EPR: 1 GB-ENG, 2 GB-SCT, 3 GB-WLS, 4 GB-NIR. nation_id smallint NOT NULL CONSTRAINT ck_reg_registration_submission_nation_id CHECK (nation_id BETWEEN 1 AND 4), application_reference_number varchar(50) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT uq_reg_registration_submission_application_reference_number UNIQUE CONSTRAINT ck_reg_registration_submission_application_reference_upper CHECK (application_reference_number = upper(application_reference_number)), status varchar(40) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT ck_reg_registration_submission_status CHECK (status IN ('InProgress', 'SubmittedForApproval', 'Queried', 'Granted', 'Refused', 'Cancelled')), created_by_user_id uuid NOT NULL, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL, submitted_for_approval_at timestamptz, latest_decision_at timestamptz );
CREATE INDEX ix_reg_registration_submission_organisation_year ON reg_registration_submission (organisation_id, registration_year);

changeSet.author: waste-submit-reg
changeSet.comment: The append-only history: who did what, and when.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE reg_registration_submission_event ( id uuid NOT NULL CONSTRAINT pk_reg_registration_submission_event PRIMARY KEY, registration_submission_id uuid NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_reg_registration_submission_event_submission REFERENCES reg_registration_submission (id), event_type varchar(40) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT ck_reg_registration_submission_event_event_type CHECK (event_type IN ('Started', 'ApplicationSubmitted', 'Granted', 'Refused', 'Queried', 'Cancelled')), user_id uuid NOT NULL, user_type varchar(20) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT ck_reg_registration_submission_event_user_type CHECK (user_type IN ('Producer', 'Regulator')), comments varchar(4000), effective_date timestamptz, occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL );
CREATE INDEX ix_reg_registration_submission_event_submission_occurred ON reg_registration_submission_event (registration_submission_id, occurred_at);

changeSet.author: waste-submit-reg
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE reg_outbox_message ( id uuid NOT NULL CONSTRAINT pk_reg_outbox_message PRIMARY KEY, type varchar(200) NOT NULL, payload jsonb NOT NULL, occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL, processed_at timestamptz, attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, error varchar(2000) );
-- The dispatcher only ever looks for unprocessed rows. CREATE INDEX ix_reg_outbox_message_unprocessed ON reg_outbox_message (occurred_at) WHERE processed_at IS NULL;
